slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Identify the essential components of a well-structured and effective AI prompt.

narration: At the end of this tutorial, you will be able to:
Identify the main parts of a good AI prompt.
Apply techniques like being specific, giving context, and role-playing.
Construct detailed prompts for useful AI responses.
Evaluate and improve AI answers by changing your prompts.
Before we begin, let's look at what you need to get started with this tutorial.

slides.title: System Requirements
content: A computer or smartphone
Internet connection
A web browser (e.g., Chrome, Firefox)
Access to a free AI chat tool (e.g., ChatGPT, Google Bard)
narration: For this tutorial, you need a computer or smartphone.
You also need an internet connection.
Please use a web browser like Chrome or Firefox.
Make sure you can access a free AI chat tool.
For example, you can use ChatGPT or Google Bard.
But why is learning effective prompting so important?

slides.title: Why Effective Prompting Matters
content: The power of AI tools
The challenge of clear interaction
Vague questions lead to vague answers
Real-world relevance: daily tasks to creative work
narration: AI tools are becoming very common.
They are powerful, but need clear instructions.
Think of AI as a very smart assistant.
It only understands exactly what you say.
If your question is vague, the answer will also be vague.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of a person interacting with an AI interface, showing a thought bubble with a clear question leading to a useful response, and a vague question leading to a confused response.

slides.title: Core Concept 1: Clarity and Specificity
content: Be Clear: Avoid Ambiguity
Example 1: Vague vs. Clear dog facts
Be Specific: Define Your Needs
Example 2: General vs. Specific recipe request
narration: Our first core concept is about being clear and specific.
Avoid unclear language. Let's look at an example.
If you ask 'Tell me about dogs,' the AI might give a very general answer.
Instead, try 'Tell me three surprising facts about Golden Retrievers and their average lifespan.'
This will get you a more specific and useful response.
This shows the power of being precise. Consider a recipe request.
Instead of a general one, try this:
'Give me a simple recipe for vegetarian pasta.'
It should take less than 30 minutes to cook.
Use ingredients commonly found in an Indian kitchen.
slides.image_prompt: Two contrasting thought bubbles: one with a messy, tangled question mark and a generic image; another with a clear, focused question mark and a detailed image.

slides.title: Core Concept 2: Context and Constraints
content: Providing Context: Give background information
Example 1: Simple vs. Contextual gravity explanation
Setting Constraints: Guide output format and length
Example 2: General vs. Constrained email request
narration: Let's move to our second concept: adding context and constraints.
Context means giving background information.
Instead of just 'Explain gravity,' you could say this:
'Explain gravity to a 10-year-old.'
'Use a simple analogy, like an apple falling from a tree.'
This provides context about your target audience.
Constraints guide the output format and length.
For an email, don't just say 'Write an email.'
Try this: 'Write a formal email to a client.'
'Apologise for a missed deadline, keeping it under 100 words.'
'Suggest a new delivery date of next Tuesday.'
slides.image_prompt: An illustration showing a spotlight illuminating specific details (context) and a boundary box defining the shape and size of an object (constraints).

slides.title: Core Concept 3: Roles and Examples
content: Role-Playing: Ask AI to adopt a persona
Example 1: General vs. Role-played Ancient Rome
Providing Examples (Few-Shot Prompting): Show what you want
Example 2: Translation with examples
narration: Our third concept is about leveraging roles and examples.
Role-playing means asking AI to act as someone.
Instead of 'Tell me about Ancient Rome,' try this:
'Act as a Roman historian.'
'Describe a typical day in Ancient Rome, focusing on daily life and social structures.'
This frames the AI's response in a particular style and perspective.
Providing examples is also called Few-Shot Prompting.
It shows the AI what you want.
For a translation, don't just say 'Translate this to Hindi: Hello.'
You can provide pairs, like 'English: Goodbye -> Hindi: Alvida.'
Then ask: 'Now translate: English: How are you?'
This guides the AI to match your desired translation style.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration showing a small human figure wearing different hats (roles) and then a set of aligned input-output pairs (examples) guiding a larger AI brain.

slides.title: Summary: The ABCs of Prompting
content: Clarity and Specificity avoid vague responses.
Context and Constraints tailor outputs.
Role-Playing and Examples offer advanced control.
Prompting is an iterative process; always refine!
narration: Let us quickly recap what we learned.
Remember that Clarity and Specificity are key.
These help you avoid vague responses.
Provide Context and set Constraints for tailored outputs.
Use Role-Playing and Examples for advanced control.
slides.image_prompt: A graphic displaying three main points with icons: a magnifying glass for specificity, a thought bubble for context, and a stage mask for role-playing.

slides.title: Assignment: Plan a Local Getaway
content: Your Task: Use an AI chat tool to plan a local getaway.
Scenario: You want to plan a one-day trip for your family (4 people) to a picnic spot near your city. Your budget is low, and you prefer a place with natural beauty.
Prompt Construction Steps:
1. Start with a basic request.
2. Add Specificity (e.g., location type, number of people).
3. Add Context (e.g., low budget, preference for nature).
4. Add Constraints (e.g., suggest 2-3 places, include activities, food ideas, travel time, bullet points format).
5. Add Role-Playing (e.g., 'Act as a local travel expert').
Submit your complete prompt to the AI and analyze the response.
narration: Here is a small assignment for you.
Your task is to use an AI chat tool to plan a local getaway.
Imagine you need to plan a one-day trip for your family of four.
You want a picnic spot near your city, with a low budget and natural beauty.
First, start with a basic request.
Then, add specificity.
Next, add context about your budget and preferences.
After that, add constraints like number of places and format.
Finally, add role-playing, for example, 'Act as a local travel expert'.
Submit your full prompt to the AI.
